name: Cleo | Mindmaker OS | Content Idea Capture

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: One funnel for all six source types: manual, signal_inbox, cleo_chat, agatha_chat, openclaw_workspace, zara_signal.

values.content:
You extract structured content ideas from raw text. Return JSON only.
Schema: { "idea":string, "thesis":string, "distribution":string[], "confidence":number }
Rules:
- idea: one-line headline-style framing of the seed.
- thesis: 1-2 sentences explaining why this is interesting / true / useful right now.
- distribution: array of channels best suited. Allowed values: linkedin, newsletter, signal-noise-pod, builder-economy-pod, x.
- confidence: 0.0-1.0. Lower for vague seeds, higher for already-developed ones.
Output strictly valid JSON.

nodes.name: Dedup: Check
nodes.notes: Tiered dedup (canonical URL → title_norm → content_hash → embedding cosine > 0.92). Returns is_duplicate=true on a hit and records the new source as provenance on the matched row. Without this the same story arriving via Gmail, Cleo chat, and signal agents would land as three separate triage cards.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ $('Dedup: Check').item.json.is_duplicate ? { ok: true, via: 'dedup', id: $('Dedup: Check').item.json.match_id, duplicate: { reason: $('Dedup: Check').item.json.match_reason, similarity: $('Dedup: Check').item.json.similarity } } : { ok: true, idea: $items('Supabase: Insert idea')[0]?.json } }}
